description: Mangrove gain and loss in hectares for 127 countries and territories, between every baseline year from 1985 to 2024 and every later year to 2025, with lower and upper 95% confidence bounds. Join to the vectors or to the country extent table on `cntry_iso3`. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for queries.
title: Mangrove gain and loss by country

providers.name: Global Mangrove Watch
providers.description: Bunting et al. (Aberystwyth University, Wetlands International, and partners) produced the v4.1.12 timeseries and published it on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0.

providers.name: Portolan Mirrors
providers.description: Maintains this Portolan mirror: the COG mosaics, GeoParquet, PMTiles, tidy statistics tables, styles, and documentation.

gmw-v4112-country-change.title: Mangrove gain and loss by country
gmw-v4112-country-change.description: One row per country, gain or loss, baseline year, and year, with the area in hectares and its 95% confidence interval.

table:columns.name: cntry_iso3
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, or one of the four producer territory codes.

table:columns.name: cntry_name
table:columns.description: English name of the country or territory.

table:columns.name: baseline_year
table:columns.description: Year the change is measured from: 1985 to 2024.

table:columns.name: year
table:columns.description: Year the change is measured to, after baseline_year.

table:columns.name: area_ha
table:columns.description: Area gained or lost between baseline_year and year, in hectares, corrected for map error by the producer. The 1985 baseline is shifted by one year; read AGENTS.md.

table:columns.name: area_ha_lower95
table:columns.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of area_ha, in hectares.

table:columns.name: area_ha_upper95
table:columns.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval of area_ha, in hectares.
